# Combat sprite sheet and transparent GIF

[All prompts](../README.md#collection) · [中文](#中文) · [Open Image 2.5](https://image-2-5.com)

A widely shared workflow for turning character art into combat frames, followed by transparency repair and GIF assembly.

**Editor adaptation · Multi-step workflow · Source-checked 2026-09-10 · Not independently tested**

<a href="https://x.com/8co28/status/2097423580229521849"><img src="https://pbs.twimg.com/media/HRuLMxZaQAAZfOo?format=jpg&amp;name=900x900" width="560" alt="Combat sprite sheet and transparent GIF — @8co28 source example" loading="lazy"></a>

Source example by [@8co28](https://x.com/8co28/status/2097423580229521849). This is the creator’s source result, not a verified output of the adapted prompt below.

## Prompt

### Step 1

```text
Use the attached character as the reference. Draw a pixel-art combat sequence in a 4-by-4 sprite sheet. Keep the character scale and ground contact consistent between cells.
```

### Step 2

```text
In a fresh chat, remove the background from the sheet, separate its 16 cells, align the character in each frame, and assemble a looping GIF.
```

## Required inputs

- A character reference; a file-processing tool for the GIF step.

## Notes

- This is an editorial recipe based on the published workflow, not a transcription of the original generation prompt.
- The creator reported a failed transparency pass and used a fresh chat to repair it. A sprite sheet is not itself an animated GIF.

[Open Image 2.5](https://image-2-5.com) and paste the prompt into the appropriate image workflow. This link currently opens the homepage and does not prefill the prompt. GIF and file-export recipes need additional processing tools.

## 中文

### 战斗精灵表与透明 GIF

把角色图转为战斗动作帧，再修复透明背景并组装 GIF 的高传播工作流。

**编辑改写 · 多步骤工作流 · 已核对原帖 · 尚未独立生图测试**

预览是原作者帖中的示例，并非本仓库使用下方提示词重新生成的结果。

### 提示词

步骤 1：

```text
以附件角色为参考，绘制 4×4 像素风战斗动作精灵表，保持每格中的角色大小与落脚点一致。
```

步骤 2：

```text
在新对话中去除精灵表背景，拆分 16 格，逐帧对齐角色并组装循环 GIF。
```

### 输入要求

- 角色参考图；GIF 步骤需要文件处理工具。

### 使用说明

- 这是依据作者公开工作流整理的编辑配方，并非最初生图提示词的逐字抄录。
